commands.keystrokes:
cat > /app/etl/rollup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Daily signup rollup for the growth dashboard.
# Usage: rollup.sh [EVENTS_DIR] [OUT_CSV]
set -euo pipefail
dir=${1:-/data/events}
out=${2:-/app/out/signups_by_plan.csv}
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
shopt -s nullglob
files=("$dir"/*.jsonl "$dir"/*.jsonl.gz)
{
  echo "plan,signups,unique_users"
  zcat -f "${files[@]}" \
    | jq -r 'select(.type == "signup") | [.event_id, (.account.plan // .plan), (.user.id // .user_id)] | @tsv' \
    | LC_ALL=C sort -u -t$'\t' -k1,1 \
    | awk -F'\t' '{ n[$2]++; if (!seen[$2 FS $3]++) u[$2]++ } END { for (p in n) print p "," n[p] "," u[p] }' \
    | LC_ALL=C sort -t, -k2,2nr -k1,1
} > "$out"
EOF

plan: Cross-check with an independent Python computation over the same files (gzip-aware, both schemas, first delivery of each event_id only).

commands.keystrokes:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import glob, gzip, json
seen, n, users = set(), {}, {}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/data/events/events-*.jsonl*')):
    op = gzip.open if f.endswith('.gz') else open
    for line in op(f, 'rt'):
        e = json.loads(line)
        if e['type'] != 'signup' or e['event_id'] in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(e['event_id'])
        plan = e['account']['plan'] if 'account' in e else e['plan']
        uid = e['user']['id'] if 'user' in e else e['user_id']
        n[plan] = n.get(plan, 0) + 1
        users.setdefault(plan, set()).add(uid)
for p in sorted(n, key=lambda p: (-n[p], p)):
    print(f'{p},{n[p]},{len(users[p])}')
EOF

analysis: The Python cross-check prints the same four rows (enterprise 15/14, pro 10/9, team 10/7, free 7/6), so the fixed script handles the compressed file, both schemas and the retries. The script still takes the events directory and output path as arguments with the old defaults.
